nodes.label: Parked Design Reference (frontend/web-page)
nodes.rationale: Not a build target: frontend/src remains the application. The directory is kept for its design work (DESIGN.md, the auth shell, the token set, the self-hosted fonts) and no routes should be added here. Porting the design work into frontend/src is the expected path.

nodes.label: AuthShell (generalised from LoginShell)
nodes.rationale: Takes heading, headingId and subtitle props so a second auth screen could reuse the split layout. login-shell.tsx is deleted and nothing references it. Committed but never verified by a build.

nodes.label: PasswordStrength (dead code)
nodes.rationale: Exists at src/components/password-strength.tsx but is imported by nothing. Started for a reset-password screen that was never built; dead code until that screen exists. Delete it or wire it up, but do not assume it works.

nodes.label: Required Product Journey (ADR-006 revised)
nodes.rationale: Login -> Triage Queue -> Patient -> Visit (Scan + Symptoms) -> AI Analysis -> Ranked Differential + Evidence -> Clinician Sign-off -> PDF Report. Revised by ADR-006 after this directory was written.

nodes.label: Frontend Design Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Clinician-assist interface, never an autonomous diagnosis product. MRI/image analysis is now in scope as a primary input per ADR-006 and the earlier exclusion here is superseded; a stage estimate may appear only as the top-ranked candidate in a ranked differential, never as a lone verdict and never beside a confidence above 92%. Patient history (trend_basis) must stay visually distinct from external evidence and citations, and simulated/live provider state, pipeline notes, uncertainty language and the disclaimer must appear prominently wherever results appear.

nodes.label: Account-Flow Handoff to the Existing Frontend
nodes.rationale: The preview runs on port 3100 and hands successful credential submission off to the existing app's /verify-otp route, configured by NEXT_PUBLIC_EXISTING_APP_URL; the shared API client uses NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL defaulting to http://localhost:8000/api/v1. Only synthetic demo credentials are to be used.
